name: fault0
netlist:
simulator lang=spectre
ahdl_include "dut.va"
ahdl_include "device.va"
Xmon (vin track y verdict) dut
Xsh (vin track y) sh_device fault=0
simulatorOptions options reltol=1e-6 vabstol=1e-9
tran tran stop=2u maxstep=0.5n
saveOptions options save=allpub
